payload.text: Before saying the tree is clean, run git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all with NO pathspec and quote the count. On 2026-09-22 cc checked -- docs/ only and twice told vc and hv nothing of its was in the tree, while its board, wip view and four canon events sat uncommitted, and those events alone would have refused the cut at step 2. The narrow answer was true; the claim was wider than what was measured.
